observedIssues.summary: Provider workflow requires release.json.releaseTag to match the requested tag, but the merged WI-18 source still declared v0.5.42 while next-release.json declared v0.5.43.
observedIssues.impact: Provider publication correctly stopped before tag mutation.
observedIssues.resolution: Promoted the candidate projection in this corrective Work Item; provider publication remains out of scope until this PR is merged and closed.

observedIssues.summary: Running finalize-release-freeze before Contract ownership produced dirty release metadata outside an active Work Item.
observedIssues.impact: repair-ai-status correctly refused to leave no-active status with unowned changed files.
observedIssues.resolution: Regenerated the Work Item after restoring only the generated files, then committed candidate metadata before candidate freeze.

observedIssues.summary: Directly promoting committed release.json to v0.5.43 broke the repository contract that published release.json remains v0.5.42 and caused nine existing release/install/governance tests to fail.
observedIssues.impact: The attempted metadata promotion was reverted; the release could not proceed through ai-finish until the projection design was corrected.
observedIssues.resolution: Changed the provider workflow to validate next-release.json and create a temporary source-bound release.json projection at runtime, leaving committed published metadata unchanged.

observedIssues.summary: Repeated ai-finish runs intermittently fail three existing E2E/governance tests inside the nested project-test stage, while the same tests pass individually, with --lf, and in standalone make project-test runs.
observedIssues.impact: The required finish gate cannot be honestly recorded as passed, so the corrective Work Item has not been archived, committed, pushed, or opened as a PR.
observedIssues.resolution: Corrected repository subprocess cleaning, E2E child-process helpers, and ai-finish command construction to remove ambient coverage/Git/Make overrides while explicitly preserving requested project quality variables; the failure was confirmed as command-line variable leakage.

residualRisks.detail: Final provider evidence, tag, assets, public URL, and post-publication quick-install verification are intentionally pending the merged corrective source.
